steps.message: Open the contacts app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.

Execute: adb shell "for pkg in com.android.contacts com.google.android.contacts; do if pm list packages | grep -q \"^package:$pkg$\"; then echo \"FOUND:$pkg\"; for perm in $(dumpsys package $pkg | sed -n '/requested permissions:/,/install permissions:/p' | grep 'android.permission' | awk '{print $1}'); do pm grant $pkg $perm 2>/dev/null; done; launch_pkg=$pkg; fi; done; if [ -n \"$launch_pkg\" ]; then monkey -p $launch_pkg -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1; echo \"LAUNCHED:$launch_pkg\"; else echo \"NO_CONTACTS_PACKAGE_FOUND\"; fi"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "for pkg in com.android.contacts com.google.android.contacts; do if pm list packages | grep -q \"^package:$pkg$\"; then echo \"FOUND:$pkg\"; for perm in $(dumpsys package $pkg | sed -n '/requested permissions:/,/install permissions:/p' | grep 'android.permission' | awk '{print $1}'); do pm grant $pkg $perm 2>/dev/null; done; launch_pkg=$pkg; fi; done; if [ -n \"$launch_pkg\" ]; then monkey -p $launch_pkg -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1; echo \"LAUNCHED:$launch_pkg\"; else echo \"NO_CONTACTS_PACKAGE_FOUND\"; fi""
